{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment=0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast bias by applying a 10-15% downward correction if model consistently overpredicts by >5% over recent 7-day window.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is positive (sentiment>0.00) and model shows early peak overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates >1.5σ from 30-day moving average, revert toward average by 50% of deviation.",
    "For sentiment=0.25, apply a 5-10% upward bias correction to offset model underestimation in early trend reversals.",
    "Avoid sharp upward spikes in forecast after 60+ days of low prices — cap maximum 3-day growth at 10% to prevent overreaction.",
    "If true outcome exceeds forecast by >10% for 3 consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 5% to prevent momentum overcorrection."
  ]
}
